messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Reference products:
These are biological products that have already been approved by the FDA, against which biosimilar products are compared.

Triplet: ["Biosimilar", "has no clinically meaningful differences from", "reference product"]

The relation 'has no clinically meaningful differences from' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject product is clinically indistinguishable from the object product, meaning there are no significant differences in safety, purity, or potency.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'equivalent to': The subject drug formulation has the same therapeutic effect or potency as the object drug formulation.
B. 'does not usually interact with': The subject drug typically does not have interactions or adverse effects when used with the object entity.
C. 'approved for same uses as': The subject drug is approved for the same medical indications or therapeutic uses as the object drug.
D. 'has same doses as': The subject drug is available in the same dose amounts as the object drug.
E. 'not stronger than': The subject drug is not more potent or effective than the object drug.
F. None of the above.
